course_name_original: DYNAMIC SIMULATION AND CONTROL OF CHEMICAL PROCESS
course_name_en: Dynamic Simulation and Control of Chemical Process

learning_outcomes.text: Understanding the development of mathematical models describing chemical process dynamics.
Understanding the application of mathematical methods to engineering problems using chemical engineering examples.
Understanding analytical and computer simulation techniques for ordinary differential equations.
Understanding the dynamic behavior of linear 1st and 2nd order systems.
Understanding the dynamics of process control and controlled processes.
Understanding the differences between steady-state and unsteady-state behavior.
Understanding the role of mathematical models used in chemical engineering in simulation.
Recognizing the effects of linear system parameters on system responses, including system stability.
Understanding the fundamentals of using Simulink for simulating dynamic systems.

syllabus_topics: Process Modeling Fundamentals and Extended Analysis of Modeling for Process Operation
Frequency Response Analysis and General Process Behavior
Frequency Response Analysis and General Process Behavior
Behaviour of Controlled Processes and Simulink
Characteristic Polynomial and Feedback Control System
Control System Components and Transfer Function Models
Mixing Process Analysis and Dynamics of Chemical Stirred Tank Reactors
Mixing Process Analysis and Dynamics of Chemical Stirred Tank Reactors
Tubular Reactors and Dynamic Analysis of Heat Exchangers
